uk.question: Як забезпечити privacy під час deployment LLM?
uk.answer: Мінімізуй дані, визнач purpose/retention, model-provider data flow, encryption і access scopes; перевір processing terms і residency requirements. Redact logs і eval samples, контролюй deletion/backups. On-prem не гарантує privacy: admin access, logs, telemetry і tools теж можуть витікати. Threat model охоплює весь workflow.

en.question: How is privacy protected when deploying an LLM?
en.answer: Minimize data and define purpose/retention, provider data flows, encryption and access scopes; check processing terms and residency requirements. Redact logs/eval samples and control deletion/backups. On-prem hosting does not guarantee privacy: admin access, logs, telemetry and tools may leak. Threat-model the whole workflow.

uk.question: Які основні threats і що таке jailbreaking?
uk.answer: Threats: prompt injection, sensitive disclosure, poisoning, unsafe output handling, excessive agency і resource abuse. Jailbreaking намагається обійти model policies; injection змінює поведінку через untrusted instructions. Mitigate із scoped tools, validation, isolation, access control і monitoring. Фільтр чи system prompt самостійно не забезпечує захист.

en.question: What are major threats and what is jailbreaking?
en.answer: Threats include prompt injection, sensitive disclosure, poisoning, unsafe output handling, excessive agency and resource abuse. Jailbreaking attempts to bypass model policies; injection redirects behaviour through untrusted instructions. Mitigate with scoped tools, validation, isolation, access control and monitoring. Filters or system prompts alone are insufficient.

uk.question: Як зменшити витік із training data?
uk.answer: Не включай unnecessary secrets/private records у training; використовуй data review, deduplication, privacy-aware training де доречно й memorization probes на approved synthetic canaries. Output filtering — додатковий control, не guarantee. Видалення з RAG index не видаляє learned information з weights; retraining/unlearning потребують окремої перевірки.

en.question: How is leakage from training data reduced?
en.answer: Exclude unnecessary secrets/private records from training; use data review, deduplication, privacy-aware training where appropriate and memorization probes on approved synthetic canaries. Output filtering is an additional control, not a guarantee. Removing RAG records does not remove learned information from weights; retraining/unlearning needs separate validation.

uk.question: Що таке data poisoning і як його попереджати?
uk.answer: Poisoning — навмисне внесення шкідливих data у training, feedback або knowledge corpus. Перевір provenance, ingestion permissions, review, anomalies й integrity; version datasets і підтримуй rollback. Test altered documents, poisoned feedback і false references у sandbox. Content validation не означає, що всі факти в source правдиві.

en.question: What is data poisoning and how is it prevented?
en.answer: Poisoning deliberately introduces harmful data into training, feedback or knowledge corpora. Check provenance, ingestion permissions, review, anomalies and integrity; version datasets and maintain rollback. Test altered documents, poisoned feedback and false references in a sandbox. Content validation does not prove every source fact true.
